mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (user_id, title, cover_image, status, audit_status, publish_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{coverImage}, #{status}, #{auditStatus}, #{publishTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, cover_image, status, audit_status, audit_time, audit_remark, visibility, is_top, like_count, comment_count, collect_count, view_count, publish_time, create_time, update_time FROM post WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
